# Atomic Agents

Skills and agents that teach agents to work with Atomic Agents. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [BrainBlend-AI/atomic-agents](https://github.com/BrainBlend-AI/atomic-agents), at commit `33d2ec9`.

Build, scaffold and debug applications with the Atomic Agents framework.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Atomic Agents**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Atomic Agents**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install atomic-agents@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

7 skills: `create-atomic-agent`, `create-atomic-context-provider`, `create-atomic-schema`, `create-atomic-tool`, `framework`, `new-app`, `troubleshoot`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

The plugin has two agents, `atomic-explorer` and `atomic-reviewer`. It ships no scripts.

The skills show example code that reads provider keys such as `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` from the environment. The plugin does not store any key.
